basic_info.description: This fully detached mid-century home, located in the highly sought-after Sherwood Forest neighborhood, is just minutes from the vibrant West Portal shops, and up the street are Mt. Davidson nature trails. Completely remodeled to the studs, this home perfectly blends modern luxury with mid-century charm.  The main level features a spacious living room with wide plank-engineered flooring, which flows through a large sliding door to an expansive ipe deckideal for seamless indoor-outdoor living. The formal dining room offers stunning ocean views and a tranquil outlook of Mount Davidson's natural beauty. The chef's grade kitchen is a true masterpiece, complete with Thermador panel-ready appliances, luxury countertops with an island, and custom European cabinetry. A stylish guest bathroom rounds out the main floor.  You'll find three spacious bedrooms and two modern bathrooms on the second floor. The master suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a huge custom walk-in closet and a spa-like bathroom designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation. The family room, equipped with a wet bar, offers an ideal space for relaxation and entertainment.  The home has been fully upgraded with all-new roofing, massive windows, electrical, and copper plumbing, and features radiant heating.
